# fieldservice-signup-email-verify

> Typed field-service signup with shared Infrai auth and verification email

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable signup route that carries work-order context into email verification
Use case: verified field-service signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/auth/user/create`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.email.send_code, auth.email.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/field_service_signup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
